text:
Type: whitewashed rattan plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant on the floor, a table or a shelf; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: coastal, bohemian, Scandinavian
Materials: coiled rattan in a whitewashed finish, inner plastic liner
Colors: pale whitewashed beige, light natural rattan
Shape: tapered round cone wrapped in tight horizontal coiled bands, wide open rim, solid medium sized planter
Feel: natural, airy, relaxed, light
Goes with: leafy green plants, white walls, light wood, linen; coastal, bohemian or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: PEKANNT
product.description: A plastic inner pot makes the plant pot waterproof.
